description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeSupervisorModel, an API model representing supervisor information and reporting methods within the OrangeHRM system. It serializes a ReportTo entity for API responses, including supervisor details and reporting method information.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing supervisor and reporting method data for API responses, based on the ReportTo entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReportTo entity and sets up filtering and attribute mapping for serialization.
